output.reason: The regulation recomposes the employer-paid JKK and JKM contribution rates by shifting part to JKP. JKK falls to 0.10%–1.60% of monthly wage by risk group and JKM to 0.20%. Employer-paid JKK and JKM premiums are part of a permanent employee's gross income for PPh 21, so these rate changes alter the PPh 21 base for employees registered in JKP. Unregistered employees and those with contribution arrears keep the old rates.
